name: Lilla Bjälkerum - Ädelfors
description: Lilla Bjälkerum to Ädelfors. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Smålands Gold Camp / Guldvaskningen i Ädelfors (service)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official HÖ5 text/miniguide says the stage passes two nature reserves and names Tjusthult, while Länsstyrelsen says Smålandsleden passes just south of Tjusthult and connects by an about 800 m yellow trail.
Official HÖ5 difficulty is Blå - medel, but Djupaskuran-Lillån reserve sources describe demanding, steep, rocky/slippery terrain with chains.
OSM and route-app/legacy sources use Etapp 1 or Etapp 1:5 Fågelhult - Ädelfors/Repperda and distances around 22.3-23.0 km, while current official HÖ5 is Lilla Bjälkerum - Ädelfors, 24.2 km.
Official sources confirm a shelter/fireplace/toilet cluster at Ädelfors. Facility/rules lanes distinguish the free municipal Klondike shelter from other nearby fee-based Gold Camp shelters/services.
Commercial Gold Camp sources mention drinking water for guests/caravans, but no official public trail water POI was found.
A 2020 field report described flooding and poor marking after clearcuts, while a sparse AllTrails 2025 signal indicates good conditions. No official closure/reroute exists.

facilities.name: Bjälkerum ledentré HÖ4/HÖ5
facilities.description: Official HÖ4/HÖ5 trail entrance at Lilla Bjälkerum. Entrance only; no official parking, toilet or water.

facilities.name: Lilla Bjälkerum shelter
facilities.description: Shelter and fire site near the start of HÖ5. No toilet or potable water confirmed. Previous HÖ4/HÖ5 field reports flagged condition/currentness and no-firewood caveats; do not promise firewood.

facilities.name: Käringens kammare side trip
facilities.description: Short side path to Käringens kammare, a historical/cultural site. Naturkartan describes a short one-way forest path; the waterfall is historical and no longer visible because water is diverted. Side-trip metadata only; not part of HÖ5 route geometry.

facilities.name: Klackenhults vattensåg side trip
facilities.description: Short side path to remains of Klackenhults water saw. Side-trip metadata only; not a facility and not part of HÖ5 route geometry.

facilities.name: Ravinkant vid Lillån
facilities.description: Viewpoint at the ravine edge by Lillån in the Djupaskuran-Lillån area. Viewpoint/side POI only; no facilities or water.

facilities.name: Djupaskuran-Lillån parking
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan parking marker; Länsstyrelsen visitor coordinate nearby at 57.43434, 15.39379
facilities.description: Small reserve parking for Djupaskuran-Lillån, about five cars according to facilities lane. Reserve access parking, not a HÖ5 endpoint. No toilet or water listed.

facilities.name: Barmarksled Djupaskuran-Lillån
facilities.description: Separate Djupaskuran-Lillån reserve loop near HÖ5. Länsstyrelsen describes demanding terrain with steep/slippery sections and chains. Linked side loop/reserve trail, not part of HÖ5 section geometry.

facilities.name: Ädelfors guldgruvor
facilities.description: Gold-mining attraction in Ädelfors; official HÖ5 text highlights Ädelfors as Sweden's oldest gold-mining landscape. Cultural attraction, not a hiker service. No water.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Höglandsleden Guldgrävarnas väg
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace at the Ädelfors Guldgrävarnas väg rest area, listed with shelter/dass/table/seating/grate in facility research. No trash bin, charcoal or nearby drinking water found. Subject to fire bans.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Höglandsleden Guldgrävarnas väg
facilities.description: Free municipal Klondike shelter at the Ädelfors/Guldgrävarnas väg rest area. Nearby private Gold Camp shelters are fee-based and should not be merged with this public shelter. Toilet is a separate record inside/near the Gold Camp area. Do not merge with fee-based private shelters.

facilities.name: Ädelfors ledentré HÖ5/HÖ6
facilities.description: Official HÖ5/HÖ6 endpoint entrance at Ädelfors. Naturkartan lists parking, shelter and fire categories in the endpoint cluster. Deduplicate with separate Ädelfors shelter/grill/toilet/rest-area records.

facilities.name: wc, Höglandsleden Ädelfors
facilities.description: Toilet at the Ädelfors Höglandsleden endpoint area. No drinking-water claim found.

facilities.name: Ädelfors bruksmuseum
facilities.description: Museum/attraction at the Ädelfors endpoint area. Opening/season unknown; attraction metadata only.

facilities.name: Smålands Gold Camp / Guldvaskningen i Ädelfors
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM way center and official commercial site
facilities.description: Commercial camping/activity/cafe/restaurant area at Ädelfors. Camping page states WC, showers, drinking water for caravan/motorhome and fire pits; cafe/restaurant is high-season/opening-hour dependent. Commercial/guest-only or opening-hour dependent; do not model as public free trail water.

facilities.name: Tjusthult reserve access / side loop
facilities.coordinateSource: Facilities lane Länsstyrelsen south information/connector point; main parking at 57.473010, 15.345790
facilities.description: Connected/nearby Tjusthult reserve access. Länsstyrelsen says Smålandsleden passes south of the reserve and an about 800 m yellow connector links to the reserve trail. Do not treat as direct HÖ5 protected-area overlap until GIS boundary intersection is verified. Tjusthult rules include no tenting, no fire and no unleashed dogs inside the reserve.
